english.note: Program-level requirements apply. Central proficient-level alternatives DET115 / Essentials9; confirm program acceptance. Central exemptions include qualifying US degree or documented first-language country/institution conditions. Scores accepted within five years with official reporting; departments may require ESL.

applicationFee.note: International fee; domestic $60. Central waivers restricted to full-time benefits-eligible employees, US military/veterans and McNair Scholars. Other applicants may inquire with department; program-specific approval is unconfirmed.

requirements.note: DVM or at least bachelor's from recognized four-year institution. Scholastic record should exceed GPA3.0 undergraduate and graduate; veterinary curriculum criterion2.75. GRE scores considered if available. Infectious Diseases and Population Medicine archive leads are concentrations within this PhD, not separate degrees.

funding.note: Central research, teaching and service assistantships may be available; departments award and set stipends. No program-wide guarantee established.
